purpose: Define evidence fields for real WordPress Playground validation. This static baseline does not claim tests have passed.
environment: Official WordPress Playground in a browser, PHP 8.3, latest supported WordPress at run time.
verificationPolicy: Do not mark a product verified until install, activation, product-specific runtime checks, manual editor/front-end behavior, and relevant compatibility checks have been recorded.

manualChecks: Open a disposable post in the editor
Confirm warnings are relevant and advisory
Create a test post with images
Check missing, empty, and present alt labels
Test readable links, empty labels, placeholder destinations, javascript: links, and target=_blank without rel=noopener
Check custom wpm, label, and suffix attributes
